title: Nostalgic Australian Wood Fired Vegetable Bake
description: A spicy and savory wood-fired bake featuring chervil and a variety of vegetables, evoking nostalgic memories of Australian cuisine, with a glassy-jelly texture from the sweet potato and carrots.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sweet potatoes, carrots, zucchini, and red bell pepper with olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a large baking sheet.
Bake the vegetables in the wood-fired oven for 30 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly caramelized.
Stir in the chopped chervil and continue to bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the chervil is wilted and the vegetables are glazed.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the wood-fired vegetable bake hot, garnished with additional chervil if desired.
